old_caption: The video captures a dynamic scene on a wooden floor where a colorful structure made of interlocking plastic blocks is being toppled over. Initially, the structure stands tall, composed of vibrant colors like red, yellow, green, blue, purple, and pink, arranged in a grid-like pattern. At the top, a white plastic piece acts as a support beam. As the video progresses, a chain reaction begins at one end of the structure, causing it to collapse in a wave-like motion. The blocks tumble down, scattering across the floor in a chaotic yet visually striking manner. The camera remains stationary throughout, focusing on the entire structure and capturing the entire sequence of the collapse from start to finish. The wooden floor provides a neutral background that contrasts with the bright colors of the blocks, emphasizing the movement and energy of the falling pieces.

caption: The video captures a large arched wall of interlocking multicolored plastic blocks—green, yellow, red, magenta, blue and purple columns—on a wooden floor against a plain wall with a baseboard, topped by a row of upright white domino-like pieces, with a curved white domino line to the right and loose blocks scattered at the far left. A progressive collapse travels along the structure from left to right. The white pieces on the upper row tilt and fall one after another, the fallen zone advancing rightward while the rightmost uprights still stand. Meanwhile the left edge of the colored wall leans outward and gives way, its blocks tumbling onto the floor and enlarging the left-hand scatter pile. The right portion of the wall and the curved domino line remain standing. The background does not shift, so the motion belongs to the blocks rather than the camera. The tumbling continues through the final frame without the structure settling.
